shortDescription: Reusable membership review screen composition for new registrations.
fullDescription: Composes the new membership registration review interface shown before payment, including the step rail, personal data summary, contact details, address, secondary membership cards, top capture action, floating quick-action button, and footer actions. The component is structured from reusable section title, detail grid, and secondary member card primitives so future membership-related views can reuse the same review layout patterns from the reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg.

shortDescription: Membership entry page for registration or member lookup.
fullDescription: Displays the membership landing screen with two top action cards for starting a new membership or opening pending processes, followed by a centered member search form. The view uses the shared MembershipLocator component to match the reference image 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg and keep the membership search-and-create layout reusable for future onboarding flows.

shortDescription: Reusable membership locator hero with action cards and search form.
fullDescription: Renders the membership access interface with a branded top bar, two large action cards, explanatory copy, and a centered search field for locating member profiles by name, phone, email, or membership number. The component supports active and inactive action-card states and can be reused by membership-related views that need a lightweight customer lookup entry screen.
